sources.snippet: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B HF — beam-4 This is a decoding-calibrated derivative of Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B-hf. The model weights and processor are unchanged. The only inference change is num_beams: 4 in generation_config.json; decoding remains deterministic with sampling disabled.
